title: Isopod
credit_line: Isopod (2025) transforms you into a tiny pill-bug navigating a huge Australian bush. You roll, zip, and slam through colourful leaves, twigs, and moss, using magnetic physics to stick, repel, and bounce. Team up with other bugs to solve puzzles, smash through obstacles, and outsmart dangerous fire-ants. Along the way, you uncover the rhythms of the ecosystem, watching plants grow, insects scuttle, and animals interact. The game blends playful, kinetic platforming with a gentle, immersive lesson in nature, showing how even the smallest creatures can make a big impact in their world.
